message: 新たなる決意

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san, we've arrived.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah, thanks...」

name: Misa
message: 「Are you really okay to be moving around already?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah, I've managed to get back on my feet. Sorry for making you worry.」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't push yourself too hard, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...So, um. Azel... well, when are you going back to Heaven?」
He glances briefly over at Lolotte.

name: Azel
message: 「The Holy Night Festival...」

name: Azel
message: 「I've heard rumors about it from Lolotte for quite some time. That it's a very enjoyable event.」

name: Azel
message: 「Since I'm already here... I intend to experience it before heading back.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see... That's a huge responsibility! Right, Lolo-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh... Y-yes! That's right! I'm itching to show what I can do!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, it's going to be lonely. Just when we finally became friends.」

name: Ria
message: 「It can't be helped. Though once you're feeling better, you can always--」

name: Azel
message: 「All I can say is that I'm sorry.」

name: Azel
message: 「Angels aren't supposed to set foot in the Human World in the first place. Moreover, I'm someone who naturally warrants suspicion.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no chance I'll be able to come back again.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying, Azel-san!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be fine! If you properly reflect on your actions in Heaven, they'll forgive you!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes... It'll be fine... Everything is going to be fine...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Even a klutzy angel like Lolo-chi was able to come to the Human World. For Azel, it'll be a total breeze!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wha?! What do you mean by that, 'extra'?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Anyway, we're going to liven up the Holy Night Festival so we can make precious memories together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. So Azel won't feel lonely even in Heaven!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't get lonely and cry, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What are you saying?! I would never...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hehehe... Well then, I'll entrust a big role to Azel, who's looking forward to the fun Holy Night Festival so much!」

name: Azel
message: 「...What is this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's an advent calendar.」

name: Synn
message: 「Try opening this window labeled '20'.」

name: Azel
message: 「A-Ah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ta-daaa! Out comes a whole roast turkey~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sure we'll get to eat delicious food at the Holy Night Festival too!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yaaay!! I wanna eat yummy food!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You count down the days until the Holy Night Festival by opening one of the windows on this calendar every day.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. So there are 6 days left.」

name: Sally
message: 「It makes you wanna open the next one right away, doesn't it~? Like, 'I wish tomorrow would hurry up and get here~'」

name: Azel
message: 「Heh... At this rate, the time until the Holy Night Festival will fly by in the blink of an eye.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...! Please look forward to it!! The Holy Night Festival!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.」
The final event we'll spend with Azel... No matter what it takes, we have to make this a huge success!

name: Synn
message: 「Alriiight. Well then, I'm gonna head home and quickly finish up the rest of the costumes!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪ Leave Azel to me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah! Call me if anything happens. I'll come running right away.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you so much, President!」

name: Azel
message: 「How affectionate.」

name: Misa
message: 「They're lovers, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「You two always look so happy~. I'm jealous!」

name: Sally
message: 「So, when is the Prez going home?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, angel. If you keep grabbing the hem of his uniform, the Demon Lord's never gonna get to go home.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Urk!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, save the lovey-dovey stuff until after the Holy Night Festival! I get that you don't want to part, but--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You'll see each other again.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「See each other... again...」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right. Ahaha!\s01 Well then, Lolotte, see you later!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Welcome back, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. We aren't home just yet.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「How was... Azel's condition?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「About that, I... have to apologize to you, Amyrina.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm thinking of returning to Heaven.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Whaaaat?!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「W-Why would you suddenly do that?! Even though you'd made up your mind so firmly...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So... I'm sorry. For doing something that betrays your feelings, Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It really is... about Azel, isn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Letting Azel go back to Heaven all alone... I'm just worried about him」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it's in the Human World, the Chairman and the others can be there by his side. However--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Then I'll... I'll stay by Azel's side! That way, you can stay together with the Chairman and everyone else, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you, Amyrina... but I couldn't possibly push that responsibility onto you」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「But you do understand, don't you? Heading to the Human World without permission is tantamount to a grave crime...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Not only me, even you, Lolotte... will be held accountable for that crime just like Azel!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be fine. I'm a dropout from Heaven, after all, so nobody really pays me much mind」

name: Amyrina
message: 「No! That's not what I mean!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「What if the way to atone for that crime...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「What will you do if it means never being allowed to set foot in the Human World again!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The truth is...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The truth is... I don't know...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What I'm supposed to do... I don't know...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even after learning so much, and experiencing so much...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When it comes to parting ways with someone... I... I don't know... what to do...」

name: Riesling
message: 「In that case, why not try speaking with Master Synn about it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is what you have always done up until now, my lady. If so, I believe that would be the best course of action」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With the Chairman...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Grandpa! Are you truly alright with never being able to see Lolotte again...?」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is for my lady to decide. Whatever path my lady chooses, I shall simply support her with everything I have」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, right this way. Please get in. Acting rather than worrying is one of your most wonderful qualities, milady」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey! Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry to have kept you waiting」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, I'm happy. Coming to see me even at this hour」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...? What's wrong? You seem kind of spaced out today...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be about Azel... Are you still worried about something!?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Lolotte? Don't tell me it's about you... Did something happen?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am going back to Heaven」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will return to Heaven together with Azel-san and Amyrina」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why...? Even though you said before that you wouldn't go back...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's something I've been thinking about for a little while now...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Re-Crea is different from what I knew in Heaven... It was something completely different from the knowledge widely known there」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In particular, if I don't properly report what happened during this Re-Crea, someone else like Azel-san will appear again...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We must never... allow such a situation to happen again. To prevent that, I need to convey the truth in Heaven myself」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, I'm... still worried about Azel-san after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Atoning for his sins in such an exhausted state... He must actually feel very lonely and anxious」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even if he tells them what actually happened, there's no telling whether they'll believe him. There is no angel in Heaven who would understand Azel-san's side of the story」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Other than Amyrina and me, who witnessed the scene firsthand, there is no one who can protect Azel-san」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I had you, President, everyone in the Student Council, and so many friends... And Jiiya, Grandfather, and Grandmother were always by my side」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why I want to be there by Azel-san's side in the exact same way!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm going back... to Heaven」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Once you make up your mind, Lolotte, you charge straight ahead... And I love that about you」

name: Synn
message: 「So if that's what you want to do, then doing it is for the best」
In truth, I want to be together forever. I don't want to part.
Yet Lolotte's resolve is far too immense.
It shows just how much she has grown up.
Even though that's something to be so, so happy about.
I'm so sad that I can't even say "See you later" in a loud voice.
So lonely.
Surely, it's because there are no guarantees.

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, it's not like we'll never see each other again」
It's probably because we can't promise to meet again that Lolotte looks so helpless right now.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I... am hesitating. Even if my heart is set, my feelings haven't caught up...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is considered taboo for an angel to set foot in the Human World. I, too, will likely be held accountable for this sin」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And there is a possibility that I will be forbidden from ever going to the Human World again...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I might never... be able to see you, President, or everyone else ever again!!」
That must be why Lolotte can't take the plunge.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uu... *sniff*... That one year in the Human World... Jiiya, Grandfather, Grandmother...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「School life living with everyone in the Student Council... KiraFes, the Holy Night Festival... The fun times and the painful times... Everything, everything...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All of those precious memories might truly end... as nothing more than memories...」
The time Lolotte spent flowing in the Human World will come to a stop.
The price called growth is far too steep, clashing against her young heart.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't know... what to do... Oh, I... *hic*... *sniff*... uu...」
Even so, hanging her head overwhelmed by sorrow isn't like Lolotte at all.
Especially since she's volunteering for such a monumental role herself.

name: Synn
message: 「Puff out your chest more! Lift your head!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wipe away your tears, Lolotte...」

name: Synn
message: 「Remember. Up until now, you've always done nothing but reckless things」

name: Synn
message: 「So I know we'll meet again... with you staying the same cheerful, reckless Lolotte you've always been...」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I... I've always believed that. I believe without a doubt that we'll see each other again!」

name: Synn
message: 「So you don't need to worry... It'll be okay...」
Unable to hold back my own tears, I pulled Lolotte into an embrace as if to hide them.

name: Synn
message: 「Come back anytime... And let's make lots more fun memories together with everyone...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President... Presideeeent...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uu... *sniff*... *snivel*... *hic*...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're... right... It only feels sad because I think of it as something sad... doesn't it...」
That's right.
This isn't goodbye. As long as we believe that, it isn't really sad at all.
I want to wholeheartedly bless Lolotte's departure.
As if holding down my sorrow, I hug Lolotte tighter and tighter.
Because if we exchange words, the tears will surely overflow and never stop.

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Hic*... *sniff*, *snivel*... President...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I can feel... so much of your kindness...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So I... shouldn't just keep crying... either, right...」
The strength in the arms clinging to me gradually fades away.
She can't keep relying on others forever. She will carve out her own future for herself.
Even as Lolotte's body pulls away, our hearts remain connected.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President... No matter what happens, I--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I promise I'll come back!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... yeah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So please, cast a good-luck charm on me so that we'll see each other again」
Lolotte stands right in front of me and slowly closes her eyes.
Such a small body.
Yet right now, she looks so much bigger than when we first met.

name: Synn
message: 「I love you, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I love you too...\s04」
And then, I put my arms around Lolotte's shoulders and press my lips to hers.
A kiss sealed with a vow to meet again.
And with a wish that Lolotte stays safe and well in Heaven--.
